originality.rationale: The all-dimensional classification and unrestricted proof that the five-cube requires four colours are not a stated consequence of the motivating 2026 primary paper or the inspected 2023 perfect-colouring classification. The latter explicitly gives \((3,3,2)\) perfect-code partitions of the seven-cube, which supply the seven-cube three-colour upper bound and are credited as prior work. The new lower obstruction applies to arbitrary, not necessarily perfect, colourings and completes the exact dimension-by-dimension classification. Equivalent unindexed work remains possible; qualified originality is supported but priority is not certified.
residual_risks: The 2023 perfect-hypercube-colouring comparator covers the seven-dimensional existence subcase; a stronger unrestricted five-cube or all-dimensional theorem from other literature could still overlap.

value.rationale: A complete classification of a newly introduced colouring invariant on Boolean hypercubes of arbitrary dimension is a natural mathematical target, with a nontrivial exceptional five-dimensional obstruction and a sharp construction threshold at the classical seven-bit Hamming syndrome. The unrestricted Q5 obstruction bridges distance-four graph extremal structure and local colour multiplicities; coupling the credited seven-cube code construction to a dimension lift yields the sharp global phase classification rather than a routine substitution into earlier cycle/multipartite formulas.
